raw.query: SELECT c.run_id, c.lead_s, c.quantile, c.numerator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_workers, c.cost_ratio, c.denominator_window_mismatch, l.p99_ms, l.n_requests, l.queue_divergent FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio AS c JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency AS l ON l.run_id = c.run_id AND l.is_current = true AND l.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' WHERE c.is_current = true AND c.policy = 'reactive' AND c.window_name = 'aggregate' AND c.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' ORDER BY c.run_id
